notes: Temporary official evidence where the available directory evidence is missing or demonstrably stale. Review after the listed expiry.

rows.name: Toshimitsu Motegi
rows.reason: The November bilateral meeting identifies Motegi as foreign minister. CIA's Japan page is dated May 2025 and still lists Takeshi Iwaya.

rows.name: Shinjiro Koizumi
rows.reason: The Ministry of Defense confirms Koizumi's reappointment. CIA's Japan page still lists Gen Nakatani, the predecessor shown in round 2.

rows.name: Roberto Velasco Álvarez
rows.reason: The October Senate record names Velasco as secretary. Wikidata returned his predecessor Juan Ramón de la Fuente in round 2.

rows.name: Kenneth Gilbert Adjei
rows.reason: The Defence Ministry reported a formal handover to Adjei. The older CIA country page still names the outgoing acting minister.

rows.name: Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro
rows.reason: The Supreme Court identifies Lazaro as Secretary of Foreign Affairs at an October 2026 official signing. The older CIA country page still names Enrique Manalo.
